text:
ryan: Heads-up — AcmeHealth non-prod POC needs private-only connectivity to Redwood API. No internet egress allowed. Who can own the network handoff?
marie: @ryan I can coordinate the handoff. Quick clarification — do they want peering or a provider-style interface endpoint? Security mentioned interface endpoints + private DNS in their questionnaire.
ajay: For cross-account, interface endpoints (PrivateLink) are simpler for access control. Customer creates the VPC endpoint in their account and shares the VPC endpoint ID with us so we can allow it on our side.
kevin: If we do interface endpoints, they need Private DNS enabled so api.redwood-inference resolves to the VPCE IPs. Otherwise we give them a DNS name to CNAME into the VPCE IPs. Also confirm whether they want split-horizon.
marie: Security questionnaire follow-up: they asked about TLS mTLS, KMS usage, and audit logs. Short answers I'll send: TLS 1.2+, we support customer-managed KMS for Private deployments, and audit logs can be exported via our Console (syslog/S3). I'll draft formal language.
ryan: POC steps proposal: 1) Customer provides target CIDR + creates subnets in 2 AZs. 2) They provision an interface endpoint (VPCE) for our API and share the VPCE ID + SG. 3) We allowlist the VPCE SG on our side and issue a scoped API key limited to the POC. Can we automate SG rule creation?
ajay: Yes — we can provide the exact SG rules. Minimal SG rule is: allow TCP 443 from the VPCE ENI SG. Example (for ops notes):
```json
{
  "Protocol": "TCP",
  "Port": 443,
  "Source": "sg-xxxxx (VPCE security group)"
}
```
No route table changes needed for interface endpoints unless they want specific egress via NAT. If customer forbids NAT, they must allow software updates through a controlled proxy.
kevin: Pricing question from the buyer: can we run the POC on a tiny Dedicated pool rather than hosted? Finance, can we offer a 14-day pro-rated dedicated trial?
marie: For most POCs we provide hosted API keys with tight rate limits. If compliance requires Dedicated, we can do a short reserved at a discounted trial price — will confirm with finance.
security-bot: security-bot: Note — Private deployment checklist: customer KMS ARN required, cross-account IAM role for image pulls, and signed data-processing addendum. See internal onboarding doc: https://redwood.example/sec/private-onboarding
ajay: Terraform example to share with customer for VPCE creation: 
```hcl
resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "rw_api" {
  service_name        = "com.amazonaws.vpce.api.redwood"
  vpc_id              = "vpc-01234567"
  subnet_ids          = ["subnet-aaa","subnet-bbb"]
  security_group_ids  = ["sg-xxxxx"]
  private_dns_enabled = true
}
```
marie: I'll send this to AcmeHealth and request: CIDR ranges, VPCE ID, KMS ARN, and security contact. Scheduling handoff meeting for tomorrow 10:00am PT — @kevin can you join for pricing?
kevin: Yep, I'll join. Also ask them expected qps, sequence length and inferred token mix so we can size batchers and recommend quantization/instance class.
ryan: Thanks everyone. Filing POC ticket: https://redwood.example/tickets/POC-5321 — I'll paste the notes and follow up after the meeting.
